title: Figure 9: Average Pore Size vs Normalized Specific Capacitance (carbide-derived carbons)
description: Scatter plot of normalized capacitance (μF/cm²) versus average pore size (nm, 0-5), divided into regions I, II and III, with a sharp rise below 1 nm labeled 'New results' and a dotted 'Traditional view' trend line. Data series include TiC-CDC, MMAC & SMAD, and other carbons, with molecular models of (CH3CH2)4N+ (0.68 nm) and BF4- (0.33 nm) ions; side panels A-D illustrate ion arrangement in pores. Caption notes that as average pore size decreases below 1 nm, specific capacitance increases due to distorted electrolyte ion solvation.
